tasks.short: Stand library, hall, cafeteria and bus duties in person.

steps.what: Perform library assistance for a pupil who cannot find a book
Do hall monitoring as one of these administrative duties
Do cafeteria monitoring while pupils eat
Direct bus loading and unloading at the school entrance

tasks.design: She still performs library assistance, hall and cafeteria monitoring, and bus loading and unloading in person. No paragraph, roster line, or second entry is part of this duty, so none of that time is removed. A tool that drafts a lesson does not stand in the hall, the cafeteria, or at the bus.
tasks.previous_blocker: The duty is being present with the pupils. A note of who walked past does not watch the hall, the cafeteria, or the bus door.
tasks.enabler_now: Nothing now removes that presence. Tools that draft a lesson or a comment do not do this task, and the digest does not describe a change for it.
tasks.still_hard: A pupil can be hurt at the kerb or in a crowded cafeteria in a moment, so she has to see it. Inferring a pupil's emotions to stand in for that watch is prohibited.
tasks.human_edge: She notices a pupil who is lost, upset, or about to step into the road, and she acts in that moment.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. She still covers library assistance, hall monitoring, cafeteria monitoring, and bus loading and unloading.

reach.task: Show which shelf holds the vocational titles
reach.learn: Start library assistance at the right case instead of walking the whole room
Keep one line at the kerb so she can see every pupil before the door closes

evidence.claim: Library assistance, hall and cafeteria monitoring, and bus loading and unloading are done by the teacher standing with the pupils.

assumptions: The four duties named in the statement are work she does in person today. Each stays at full time because the design does not change that presence.
Shares follow how long each duty lasts in a normal week of this task: hall passes add up to the most, then the cafeteria sitting, then the two bus doors, then occasional library help.
There is no second entry into another system in this task, and she does not file a roster as part of it, so no filing time is removed.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
Lesson plans, marks, and pupil reports are other tasks. They are outside this duty.
If a teaching assistant already stands the bus door, that time is not hers. The saving on this task is still zero.
unknowns: Whether this school assigns bus loading to the teacher or to a colleague.
Whether library assistance is a scheduled duty or occasional cover.
research_questions: Who stands the bus door on a normal week, the teacher or a teaching assistant?

already_counted.description: She still performs library assistance, hall and cafeteria monitoring, and bus loading and unloading.

incremental.description: No list or template is kept for these duties. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: She still stands each duty. A short library cover or a bus door a colleague already owns does not create a saving, because no step in this task is removed. The high stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week does not change. She still stands library assistance, hall monitoring, cafeteria monitoring, and bus loading and unloading.
reach: A librarian can show which shelf holds the vocational titles, so library assistance starts at the right case.
A teaching assistant can show the bus door line, so she sees every pupil before the door closes.
skills_to_grow: Read the kerb before the bus door closes.
Notice a pupil who leaves the cafeteria line.
role.ambitious_version: The week is unchanged. She still covers the library, the hall, the cafeteria, and the bus.
